name: Astral-Fjard
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by magnetic pole anomalies. Farther poleward, past massive canyon systems, the silence feels older than the soil.

Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
Approach protocols for the smuggler cache are simple: announce once, dock slowly, compliment the cooking.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
